name: ubiquitin specific peptidase 6

function.text: USP6 encodes ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 6. Annotated molecular activities include cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity and cysteine-type endopeptidase activity. It participates in protein deubiquitination and protein modification process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: USP6 rearrangements can produce promoter-driven overexpression in primary aneurysmal bone cysts. These alterations support a neoplastic process in this lesion and should not, by themselves, be interpreted as evidence of malignancy.
